enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Remain asleep. Breathe slowly. Shift legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks and shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Place items into bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Check mirrors. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Arrive at facility. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care, clinical rounds, charting and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at facility. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Check IV. Adjust drip rate. Talk to patient. Record notes. Coordinate with care team. Update charts.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Check mirrors. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Arrive home. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Open front door. Enter.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot and pan. Turn on stove. Cook food. Stir food. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork and knife. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Carry dishes to sink. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Type URL. Scroll webpage. Click link. Read content. Open messaging app. Type message. Send message. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing next day's lunch and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out lunchbox. Prepare sandwich. Place sandwich in lunchbox. Put lunchbox in refrigerator. Take out snack. Eat snack.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
